nominations.description: David MacNeil, of Florida, to be a Federal Trade Commissioner for the term of seven years from September 26, 2025, vice Melissa Holyoak, term expired.
nominations.actionText: Received message of withdrawal of nomination from the President.

nominations.description: Joshua Shoemaker, of Virginia, to be Chief Financial Officer, National Aeronautics and Space Administration, vice Margaret Vo Schaus, resigned.
nominations.actionText: Referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation as requested by Senator Cantwell.

nominations.organization: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
nominations.description: Gary Lawkowski, of Virginia, to be General Counsel of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, vice John Dever, resigned.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Select Committee on Intelligence.

nominations.description: Michael LoSapio, of New Jersey, to be Director of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, Department of Homeland Security, vice Jen Easterly, resigned.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

nominations.description: Arthur Kleinschmidt, of Virginia, to be an Assistant Attorney General, vice Amy Lefkowitz Solomon, resigned.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

nominations.description: Christopher Mufarrige, of Texas, to be a Federal Trade Commissioner for the term of seven years from September 26, 2026, vice Alvaro M. Bedoya, term expired.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

nominations.description: Fernando Campoamor-Sanchez, of the District of Columbia, to be an Associate Judge of the Superior Court of the District of Columbia for the term of fifteen years, vice Peter Arno Krauthamer, retired.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

nominations.description: Joseph Patrick Falvey, of Indiana, to be United States District Judge for the Northern District of Indiana, vice Philip P. Simon, retiring.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
